work.note: 433000 dates composition to the years after the plague of 1348 and distinguishes early-1350s readers from the later Hamilton 90 autograph. The coarse interval reflects that existing dating language, not a claim of a precisely known decade-long composition.
work.label: After 1348; circulating in the early 1350s

setting.note: The Florence plague of 1348 is the narrative frame; it is not the date of composition of every embedded tale.

witness.note: 433000 dates Boccaccio’s surviving Hamilton 90 autograph approximately to 1370; this is a late authorial witness, not first composition.
witness.label: c. 1370 · Hamilton 90
